title: I made Unshielded, an arcade territory-capture game across the Solar System (made with Godot, Windows & Android)
author: Individual_Battle686
selftext:
Hi everyone! After many evenings of work, my game Unshielded is out.



The idea is simple: you have to leave the safety of your shield to cut through the alien hulls covering each world. Close a shape and the planet hidden underneath is revealed. But while you're out there, the Guardian, its minions or your own burning fuse can catch you.



\- 23 worlds, from Mercury to the Kuiper Belt, each Guardian with its own power

\- Two pilots: one tough, one fast

\- Arcade mode with high scores, or Training on the worlds you've unlocked

\- Duel against the computer or a friend on the same PC



Trailer: [https://youtu.be/jsf0Ng3XLDA](https://youtu.be/jsf0Ng3XLDA)

Page: [https://flibustier54.itch.io/unshielded](https://flibustier54.itch.io/unshielded)



It's my first paid game ($4). I'd really love your honest feedback: what's fun, what's frustrating, how far you got.



(Transparency: the art and music were made with AI tools, the game itself is designed by me.)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Individual_Battle686 please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
